about: Curated shortlist of scriptable, commercially usable music for 20-60 s premium tech launch films. Every file_url answered HTTP 200 on 2026-11-22. Mood words, energy and good_for are inferred from catalogue tags, genre and metadata, NOT from listening: audition before locking. bpm_measured and first_beat_s are measured from each file (a comb of the onsets over the whole track); tracks with a tempo_note have no steady grid. good_from_s is the second the track is established. sfx.mjs music measures the fetched file again and sfx.mjs fit places it. All tracks are human-made library music; no AI.

mixkit-music-free.name: Mixkit Stock Music Free License
mixkit-music-free.note: Mixkit states commercial use in web videos, social media and online ads is allowed with no attribution. Per secondary sources it excludes games, CD/DVD and TV/radio broadcast. The licence text loads in a JS modal on https://mixkit.co/license/ so it could not be fetched by script: read it once by hand before shipping. Content ID behaviour is not stated.

cc-by-4.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
cc-by-4.0.note: Commercial use allowed. Credit line must appear in the video description/credits (field credit per track).
